facts.fact: The Independent reports that the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance launched a multi-year National Data Strategy on 20 October 2026, which the Uganda Bureau of Statistics rejected the next day as illegal and redundant.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

UGA.note: The document describes a data strategy, not a national digital strategy.

facts.fact: UBOS says the Uganda Bureau of Statistics Act 1998 (Cap 333) makes UBOS the principal agency for collecting, coordinating, monitoring and supervising the National Statistical System, per The Independent.

UGA.note: The Plan for National Statistics Development is named only in passing, with no adoption date or period.
